shortDescription: Australia's Ingenia Communities ASX:INA said on Monday it has rejected a takeover proposal from private equity firm Warburg Pincus and its affiliates that values the property developer at about A$1.94 billion ($1.40 billion).($1 = 1.3883 Australian dollars)
